faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers before you get in touch.

q1.question: What does the free consultation include?
q1.answer: A conversation about your goals, your background and the visa options that may suit you. We explain the next steps and any costs before you commit to anything.

q2.question: What documents will I need?
q2.answer: It depends on your visa. Typical documents include your passport, identity records, evidence of relationships or qualifications, and financial or employment records. We give you a personal checklist after your consultation.

q3.question: How long does a visa application take?
q3.answer: Processing times vary by visa type, country and how complete your application is. We set out realistic timelines for your visa during the consultation.

q4.question: Can you guarantee a visa outcome?
q4.answer: No consultant can guarantee a visa outcome, because decisions rest with the Department of Home Affairs. We aim to make your application as strong and complete as possible.

q5.question: Do I need to be in Australia to apply?
q5.answer: Some visas can be applied for from overseas and others from within Australia. Tell us your location and we will confirm which options are available to you.

q6.question: How is my personal information handled?
q6.answer: Your information is used only to assess and manage your enquiry and application. Read our Privacy Policy for full details on how it is collected, stored and protected.

Our mission is to take the stress and guesswork out of your application through meticulous document checking, honest eligibility evaluations, and responsive human support at every stage.

about.disclaimerBody: Fortune Visa Services provides administrative document preparation, translation coordination, and general procedural guidance. We are not registered migration agents (MARA) and do not provide legal migration advice. When formal legal advice is required, we direct clients to registered legal practitioners.
